title: Elbit Systems Awarded a Contract to Supply Naval EW Suites for Germany
summary: Elbit Systems Ltd.'s German subsidiary, Elbit Systems Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG ("Elbit Systems Deutschland"), was awarded a contract to supply naval Electronic Warfare (“EW”) suites. The contract will be performed over a period of 5 years.
body_markdown:
Elbit Systems Ltd.'s German subsidiary, Elbit Systems Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG ("Elbit Systems Deutschland"), was awarded a contract to supply naval Electronic Warfare (“EW”) suites. The contract will be performed over a period of 5 years.


Under the contract with TKMS, Elbit Systems Deutschland will supply the[Aqua Marine™](https://www.elbitsystems.com/naval/naval-ew-sigint/esm-elint-comint/aqua-marine) , an integrated naval EW self-protection suite for the German Navy’s F-128 frigates. The advanced and modular suite combines passive and active EW capabilities, enabling the detection, identification and analysis of threats, alongside advanced electronic self-defense and electronic attack capabilities. Designed for complex and dense environments, the system delivers enhanced situational awareness, fast response, electronic intelligence and interoperability across naval platforms.


> **Marian Rachow, CEO of Elbit Systems Deutschland, emphasized:** "The contracts to equip the new F128-class frigates with state-of-the-art systems for combat in the electromagnetic spectrum underscore the relationship of trust between the prime contractor, TKMS, and Elbit Systems Deutschland, which has grown through various joint projects. Together, we are committed to providing the German Navy with the equipment it needs to carry out its challenging missions."
